The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Removed the oscillator-based beep from [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts:78). Card activation still updates the same game state, preserving matches, announcements, and the visual win effect. A source search found no audio APIs or audio elements in `src` or `index.html`.

I didn’t run the test suite.
